_comment: Runtime probe pinned for automate-followups/33 (A6). Observed on Claude Code 2.1.286, 2026-10-07, in the Supervisor session that produced the change (plugin session log + parent/subagent transcripts read directly; nothing below is inferred). Consumers: emit-lifecycle.sh `ended` (seam choice) and test-emit-lifecycle.sh (the task_return / async_launched payload cases). Re-probe on a runtime upgrade before relying on `maxturns_stop_fires_subagentstop: false`.

findings.maxturns_stop_evidence: plan-reviewer agent a3a900c6391132581 (blocking Task, maxTurns 20) stopped at its turn limit at ~05:33:26Z. Its own transcript holds exactly ONE attachment.type=hook_success with hookEvent SubagentStop, at 05:34:04Z — AFTER a SendMessage resume of the same agent ended normally (stop_reason end_turn). No SubagentStop fired for the turn-limit stop itself. Session log: agent_identity at 05:33:26 (PostToolUse[Task] -> emit-agent-identity.sh when the blocking Task returned) and the agent's only token_ledger row at 05:34:04 (the resumed run's normal stop).
findings.turn_limit_marker_evidence: The parent transcript's toolUseResult for that turn-limit return reads status "completed" — byte-identical in shape to a normal blocking return. The hook payload's tool_response mirrors toolUseResult (compare progress-event-fixtures/spawn-probe-2026-09-02/posttooluse-task-*.json). So no turn-limit reason is recordable from either seam on this runtime.
findings.background_launch_evidence: Across this machine's transcripts every run_in_background Task result carries status "async_launched" with keys agentId,canReadOutputFile,description,isAsync,outputFile,prompt,resolvedModel,status — PostToolUse[Task] for a background spawn fires at LAUNCH, while the child still runs.
findings.subagentstop_payload_keys_source: progress-event-fixtures/spawn-probe-2026-09-02/subagentstop-1.json — no stop-reason key; agent_type present for a non-plugin type (probe-alpha).

not_verified: Whether a BACKGROUND child stopped at its turn limit fires any hook at all (neither seam observed) — treated as uncoverable; the join keeps it unsettled.
Whether a general-purpose / Explore SubagentStop payload carries agent_type on 2.1.286 specifically — the committed evidence is a custom non-plugin type (probe-alpha) on an earlier runtime.
